rationale: DS.AI.010 expressly excludes AI-based systems whose risk directly contributes to fatalities or multiple life-threatening injuries and excludes specified online-learning cases. The claim's conclusion is conditional: the proposal cannot be presented as a complete path for the project's most demanding flight-critical case. That follows unless a function-level hazard allocation places the concrete DAA role outside the stated exclusion; the claim expressly requires such allocation before classification.
evidence_locators: S-CHAL-002-R1, EASA NPA 2025-07(B), DS.AI.010 Scope, PDF p. 4
limitations: No aircraft-level functional hazard assessment or DAA failure-condition allocation has been reviewed, so this cannot classify a real DAA implementation.
The source remains proposed material rather than final EASA policy.
